plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Health Science Major (BS) program page (poid=915). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The recorded total is the program requirement as printed on the program page; the full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. Courses titled 'with Lab' carry separate 0-Hour(s) lab corequisites in the catalog, disclosed in these notes and not placed as separate courses. Catalog anomaly, transcribed as printed and not corrected: CHEM 120's detail page prints its prerequisite as 'XXX 111', a course that does not exist in this catalog, so CHEM 120 carries no recorded prerequisite; the same 'XXX 111' string appears in the printed prerequisites of HSCI 200, HSCI 290 and HSCI 370. The catalog states the BS requires 74 to 79 hours of coursework, of which 55 to 60 hours are in the science, mathematics and data interpretation core and the advanced science courses. The recorded total (78) is inside the printed range, exercised as: core 39 (fixed 35 + statistics slot at 4, the value at which the core sums to its printed 39 hours) + advanced science 20 + experiential 10 (the block's printed total) + interdisciplinary perspectives 9 (the block's printed total) = 78; core + advanced = 59, inside the printed 55-60 science range. CATALOG DISCREPANCIES, disclosed and not reconciled: the advanced-science blocks itemize to 19-22 hours against the printed 16-21 (the itemized minimum alone exceeds the printed minimum by 3), and at itemized maximums the degree sums to 81 against the printed 79 maximum; at itemized minimums it sums to exactly the printed 74 minimum (core 38 + advanced 19 + experiential 8 + interdisciplinary 9). The itemized sums stand as recorded, per the Salem precedent for printed-minimum gaps (Wave88 Biochemistry). STRUCTURAL READING, disclosed: the five ethics courses printed under Interdisciplinary Perspectives carry no choose wording on the page, but the printed 9-hour block total and the printed 74-hour degree minimum both hold only if that list is choose-one alongside the Written/Oral and Cultural choose-one blocks (see the ethics slot note); recorded on that reading, not silently. The BS page prints no 'Required:' line and no SOCI 100 requirement in this block; its introduction instead encourages SOCI 100 as part of the Salem Impact Social Science requirements, disclosed here. Advanced science exercise: the Understanding Disease slot is recorded at 3 listing the two 3-Hour(s) PUBH options, with the four 4-Hour(s) BIOL options (BIOL 225 Parasitology, BIOL 280 Immunology, BIOL 235 Microbiology with Lab, BIOL 311 Evolution) disclosed on the slot; the Principles of Natural Science slots are recorded at 4 (all four options are 4 Hour(s)); the Advanced Natural Science slots are recorded at 3 listing the three 3-Hour(s) options, with BIOL 312 Genetic Explorations (2) and EXER 310 Exercise Physiology with Lab (4) disclosed on the slots. The catalog's printed lab corequisites in this plan are BIOL 100L, BIOL 101L, BIOL 205L (when BIOL 205 is the statistics choice), BIOL 218L, BIOL 219L, CHEM 110L, CHEM 120L, CHEM 201L, CHEM 202L, PHYS 210L, PHYS 220L and EXER 310L (when EXER 310 is an advanced-science choice), each 0 Hour(s). Catalog anomalies disclosed, not corrected: HHMN 320's stated cross-list partner RELI 320 does not exist in this catalog (established in Wave90); PUBH 260's title is spelled 'Intoduction' [sic]. No residency note is printed for this program.

courses.choice_note: Required in the Experiential Learning and Professional Development block. Printed at 1-4 Hour(s) on its detail page and recorded here at 3, the value at which the block sums to its printed 10 hours (1 + 2 + 3 + 1 + 3); at 1 hour the block totals 8 and at 4 hours it totals 11, as printed. courses.title: Interdisciplinary Perspectives: Ethics
courses.choice_note: Choose one course for the ethics part of the Interdisciplinary Perspectives Courses block. The program page prints the five ethics courses with no subheading and no choose wording; the block's printed total of 9 hours holds only as one ethics course (3) + the Written and Oral Communication choose-one (3) + the Cultural Awareness choose-one (3), and at itemized minimums the whole degree then sums to exactly the catalog's printed 74-hour minimum, so the block is recorded on that reading and the ambiguity is disclosed here and in the plan notes. All five options are printed at 3 Hour(s), in the BS page's printed order. HHMN 215 is cross-listed with WGSS 215 and RELI 215 (neither is a separate option in this block, as printed); HHMN 320's detail states a cross-listing with RELI 320, which does not exist in this catalog (see plan notes).
